slides.headline: What's the real difference?
slides.body: Major banks often require extensive documentation and longer processing times, generally suiting well-established businesses with strong financials. Non-bank lenders can offer more flexible assessment criteria and faster processing, though pricing and terms vary widely across the broader non-bank market.

caption:
Most business owners default to their existing bank, without realising there's a much broader market of non-bank commercial lenders assessing businesses differently.

Banks often suit well-established businesses with complete financials and time to spare. Non-bank lenders can move faster and assess more flexibly, though the market varies widely lender to lender.

General information only. This does not constitute financial, legal, accounting or tax advice. Credit is subject to lender assessment, eligibility and approval criteria. Fees, charges, terms and conditions may apply.
